value.rationale: The formula completely determines a natural fixed-target commutator word-map invariant for the first triangular matrix algebra with nonzero product of radical layers. It separates zero, simple-root and highest-root commutator strata, showing that unlike square-zero radical examples nonzero commutator targets need not share a fiber size, and yields exact commuting counts and all-field surjectivity. This answers a meaningful orbit/fiber distribution question rather than a preset small numerical exercise.
